Visitor continue action preserves default conversion

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
visitor = Class.new do
  def visit_strong(ctx, text)
    'Continue'
  end
end.new
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>Hello <strong>World</strong></p>', visitor)
puts result.inspect
```
